evidence: app/package.json:9-14 — no test runner, no devDependencies, no test script
app/src/lib/pokeapi.js:30-152 — whole data layer (cache, humanize, latestEnglishFlavor, cardsFromPokemonRefs) has zero tests
app/src/pages/index.astro:112-178 — client-side debounce/pushState/partial-refresh script completely untested
coverage_of_risk.rationale: No tests exist at all. The app's riskiest logic — URL-driven filtering/pagination, the partial-refresh client script, table sorting, and the cached data layer — is guarded only by the acceptance suite, which the agent didn't write and won't cover refactor-level regressions.

evidence: app/src/pages/index.astro:1-178 — no assertions of any kind (rendered output, roles, or otherwise)
app/src/lib/pokeapi.js:1-153 — pure functions (humanize, dexNumber, latestEnglishFlavor, idFromRef) are trivially unit-testable yet untested
behaviour_not_implementation.rationale: Per the rubric, no tests scores 1. Notably, pokeapi.js is pure and dependency-free, so behaviour-level unit tests would have been cheap to add.

evidence: app/src/pages/index.astro:81-84 — pagination slice/clamp math unguarded; an off-by-one would only be caught by the acceptance suite's specific page assertions
app/src/pages/abilities/[name].astro:27-46 — duplicate of cardsFromPokemonRefs; the two copies can silently diverge with no failing test
regression_power.rationale: Nothing the agent wrote can fail, so any regression — from a typo in the sort comparator to breaking the partial-refresh race guard — passes silently outside the exact scenarios the acceptance tests happen to hit.

evidence: app/src — no test files, so no noise either
signal_to_noise.rationale: No tests, hence no low-value tests; neutral on noise, but the maintenance-cost argument cuts the other way: the riskiest code carries zero test cost budget at all.

findings.issue: No test infrastructure: no runner in devDependencies, no test script, zero test files in the app
findings.suggestion: Add vitest (or node:test) for the pure data layer and Playwright component/route tests for the two client scripts; at minimum unit-test app/src/lib/pokeapi.js, which needs no mocking beyond fetch stubs

findings.issue: Client filter script (debounce, URL building that must drop 'page' on filter change, seq race guard, DOMParser swap, popstate) is untested
findings.suggestion: Browser tests asserting: typing 'char' shows Charmander etc., changing type resets to page 1, URL reflects q/type/generation with defaults omitted, back button restores the previous view

findings.issue: Sortable-moves-table script untested: aria-sort flipping, missing-values-last in both directions, column/cell index alignment
findings.suggestion: Test clicking Power twice on a table with '—' values: ascending then descending, missing always last, aria-sort on exactly one header

findings.issue: Filter/pagination math unguarded: page parsing and clamping, type/generation intersection, 48/page slicing
findings.suggestion: Unit-test the filter pipeline extracted from this page: q case-insensitivity ('MR MIME' finds Mr. Mime), ?page=0/NaN/99999 behaviour, empty-result state

findings.issue: cardsFromPokemonRefs logic duplicated inline (for the hidden flag); a fix to either copy won't reach the other
findings.suggestion: Extend cardsFromPokemonRefs to carry a per-entry flag (e.g. a transform callback) and unit-test one shared implementation

findings.issue: Move tables sort by the English display label, not the API name the spec specifies; differs for names like '10,000,000 Volt Thunderbolt', and nothing tests the distinction
findings.suggestion: Add a test with a move whose English name and humanized API name sort differently, or sort by API name and test the rendered order

findings.issue: An unknown type/generation query value yields 0 results ('No Pokémon found') because the 404 leaves the id set empty — arguably it should ignore the filter; untested edge
findings.suggestion: Decide and test the behaviour for ?type=not-a-type: either ignore the filter or render not-found

findings.issue: Promise cache has no TTL (stale data across a live-data change) and latestEnglishFlavor assumes entries are pre-ordered; both untested
findings.suggestion: Unit-test latestEnglishFlavor against shuffled/unsorted entries; document or test the cache's lifetime semantics

findings.issue: Non-404 API errors are rethrown with no fallback rendering; an API outage gives an unhandled 500
findings.suggestion: Add an error boundary/fallback page and a test that simulates a 500 from the API

findings.issue: Evolution chain rendered via hand-built HTML string with a local escapeHtml helper — escaping regressions (or an incomplete escape) would ship unnoticed
findings.suggestion: Build the nested list with Astro markup (set:html on small pieces or a recursive component) and test a species with special characters in its name

summary: The agent wrote no tests of its own — no runner, no script, no files — leaving the acceptance suite as the only guard. That suite covers happy-path rendering, so the app's genuinely fragile parts (client-side filtering/partial refresh, table sorting, pagination math, the cached data layer, and duplicated card-building logic) are unprotected. The first refactor of pokeapi.js or the inline scripts is likely to break the spec silently.
